source_id: Va. Code ss 63.2-600 through 63.2-621 (tit. 63.2, subtit. II, ch. 6)

Currency: the register's own 2026 Updates page (https://law.lis.virginia.gov/vacodeupdates/) states 'this is a list of updated sections that took effect on July 1, 2026, unless otherwise noted', so the online Code reflects the 2026 session. The site marks future text as '(Effective <date>)' and dead text as 'Repealed', and the cited provisions carry neither marker. Note that article-level URLs such as /vacode/title40.1/chapter3/article2/ return HTTP 200 with an EMPTY content pane, so the citable register page for an article is its chapter page, which prints the article heading and its section list.
notes: Chapter 6 is the principal cash-assistance statute within Subtitle II (Public Assistance) of Title 63.2; ch. 5 (General Provisions, ss 63.2-500 to 63.2-527) and ch. 8 (Other Grants of Public Assistance) sit alongside it. Unemployment benefits are Title 60.2 ch. 6, listed under Termination/severance.
